almost.notes: Depending on the card used to prevent combat damage, additional mana and pre-requisites may be required.
almost.prerequisites: An opponent controls a creature.
produces: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
requires: Card Preventing Combat Damage Dealt To/By a Creature
almost.steps:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
If needed, cast the card preventing combat damage by paying its mana cost or activate it.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking an opponent who controls a creature.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt is prevented due to the damage prevention effect.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

The creature triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

almost.notes: This combo will also deal damage to you equal to 13 times the number of creatures you control. It is recommended that your life total is above this number to ensure you don't lose the game from the damage if your opponents will not take lethal damage from this combo.
almost.steps:

Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Sword of Feast and Famine attached.
Sword of Feast and Famine triggers, causing that opponent to discard a card, and you to untap all lands you control.
Proceed to your postcombat main phase.
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this phase.
Repeat.

almost.notes: This combo can fail if you roll less than a 5 and do not control enough Treasures to make up the difference. You can control creatures that tap for mana and/or have additional mana to start the combo and reduce the chance of failure. You can also carry over Treasures from prior iterations to cover the difference.

You have enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery, plus an additional
produces: Infinite copies of instant and sorcery spells on the stack
almost.steps:
Cast any other instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, as well as Thousand-Year Storm if you've cast another instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, if applicable, copying the spell at least once.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve each copy of the instant or sorcery.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Thousand-Year Storm and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Narset's Reversal, with each copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy made this way, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Narset's Reversal with the copy targeting the spell cast in step 1, and then returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
All remaining Narset's Reversal copies made in step 11 fizzle due to having no legal target.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy from step 13, copying the spell it is targeting and returning the original spell to your hand.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of the spell.
Activate any number of Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat this combo targeting any other instant and/or sorcery card in your hand and/or on the stack.

almost.prerequisites: Curiosity attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer. You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
almost.steps:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Curiosity triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

almost.prerequisites: You have an additional three cards in your graveyard if Frantic Search is in your graveyard. You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}. You have cast at least one instant or sorcery spell this turn.
produces: Near-infinite mana lands you control can produce
Near-infinite untap of lands you control
almost.steps:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search either from your hand by paying {2}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Frantic Search for each instant or sorcery you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve the first copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the original Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat from step 2.

almost.prerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Niv-Mizzet. Niv-Mizzet does not have summoning sickness. You have a way to give Niv-Mizzet deathtouch.
produces: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control
Destroy all nontoken creatures opponents control
almost.steps:
Give Niv-Mizzet deathtouch by any method.
Activate Niv-Mizzet by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, and destroying the creature due to Niv-Mizzet's deathtouch.
The creature dies, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping Niv-Mizzet.
Repeat.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

almost.prerequisites: You have an additional instant card in hand.
almost.steps:
Cast any other instant card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Spelljack by paying {3}{U}{U}{U} targeting the instant.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating at least one copy of Spelljack that is targeting the original Spelljack.
Resolve the first copy of Spelljack, countering the original Spelljack and exiling it with the ability to cast it for free from exile.
All remaining copies of Spelljack fail to resolve due to having no legal targets.
Cast Spelljack from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the instant cast in Step 1.
Repeat from step 3.
